tools.title: Get Channels
tools.name: get-channels
tools.description: Lists all channels in the Slack team

tools.title: Get Channel History
tools.name: get-channel-history
tools.description: Fetches a channel's history of messages and events.

tools.title: Read Conversation
tools.name: read-conversation
tools.description: Read messages from a Slack channel, DM, group DM, user DM, or pasted Slack message permalink. When given a U or W user ID, it opens or finds that DM and returns its D-prefixed channel ID; use this to resolve a person before Upload Files. A permalink returns the referenced message and its thread.

tools.title: Get Users
tools.name: get-users
tools.description: List all users in the Slack team

tools.title: Find Users
tools.name: find-users
tools.description: Find Slack users by name, username, display name, or email address. Use this to resolve a person to a user ID. Before uploading files to that person, pass the user ID to Read Conversation and use its returned DM channel ID.

tools.title: Set Status
tools.name: set-status
tools.description: Set or unset the status of the current user

tools.title: Get Emojis
tools.name: get-emojis
tools.description: List all custom emojis in the Slack team

tools.title: Search Messages
tools.name: search-messages
tools.description: Search all Messages in the Slack team

tools.title: Read Thread
tools.name: read-thread
tools.description: Read a bounded page of messages in a Slack thread. Use this when the user asks to summarize, inspect, or answer questions about a specific threaded conversation. Requires the channel ID and the parent message timestamp, which can come from Get Channel History or Search Messages. The response includes hasMore and nextCursor so more messages can be fetched when needed.

tools.title: Open Group DM
tools.name: open-group-dm
tools.description: Open or resume a Slack group DM with 2 to 8 users. Use Find Users first to resolve each person to a user ID. Do not include the authenticated user. Returns a group conversation ID that can be passed to Send Message or Upload Files.

tools.title: Send Message
tools.name: send-message
tools.description: Send a Slack message to a channel, group DM, existing DM, or user. Pass a conversation ID or user ID and the message text. When given a user ID, the tool opens or finds the DM first. For messages with file attachments, use Upload Files instead.

tools.title: Update Message
tools.name: update-message
tools.description: Edit a Slack message posted by the authenticated user. Requires the channel ID, message timestamp, and complete replacement text. Use the permalink or a read/search tool to resolve the message first when needed.

tools.title: Add Reaction
tools.name: add-reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a Slack message. Requires the channel ID, message timestamp, and Slack emoji name. Use Get Emojis to discover custom workspace emoji names.

tools.title: Reply to Thread
tools.name: reply-thread
tools.description: Post a reply to a Slack thread. Requires the channel ID, the parent message timestamp, and the reply text. Use Read Thread first when context is needed. For replies with file attachments, use Upload Files instead.

tools.title: Get Huddle Link
tools.name: get-huddle-link
tools.description: Get a Slack Huddle join link for a channel, DM, group DM, or user. Pass a conversation ID or user ID. When given a user ID, the tool opens or finds the DM first.

tools.title: Upload Files
tools.name: upload-files
tools.description: Upload one or more local files to a Slack channel, DM, group DM, or thread, optionally with message text. The channel must be a C, D, or G conversation ID; never pass a U or W user ID. For a named person, use Find Users, then Read Conversation, then pass its returned D-prefixed channel ID here. Pass multiple absolute file paths separated by newlines.
